name: M6.RecipeIsometries.conv_multiply
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) (a h : M6.RecipeIsometries.Block N), M6.Physical.conv N (M6.RecipeIsometries.multiply N u a) (M6.RecipeIsometries.multiply N u h) = M6.RecipeIsometries.multiply N u (M6.Physical.conv N a h)
guidance: Reindex the finite sum by the genuine equivalence u.mulLeft from Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Units.Equiv (works for units in any monoid; do not assume ZModN is a multiplicative group). Use inverse-unit cancellation and uinv*(i-u*k)=uinv*i-k. Both recipe and input coefficients are permuted. Return tactic proof lines without leading by, retaining the exact frozen statement and default limits.
